summary: Shoreham airspace hours set at 0800-2000 Monday to Friday, 0900-2000 Saturday and 0900-1900 Sunday.
text:
ATS AIRSPACE - ADD SHOREHAM ATZ HOURS
MON-FRI   0800-2000 (0700-1900)
SAT       0900-2000 (0800-1900)
